items.exampleEn: Washing your hands can stop many diseases.
items.exampleZh: 洗手可以阻止許多疾病。

items.exampleEn: Our bodies are made of cells.
items.exampleZh: 我們的身體是由細胞組成的。

items.exampleEn: She felt a sharp pain in her knee.
Scientists are looking for new ways to fight cancer.
items.exampleZh: 科學家在尋找對抗癌症的新方法。

items.exampleEn: Point at the picture with your finger.
The player missed three games because of an injury.
items.exampleZh: 那位球員因為受傷缺席了三場比賽。

items.exampleEn: I could see my breath in the cold air.
items.exampleZh: 在冷空氣中，我看得到自己哈出的氣。
很多鳥的胸前是白色的。

items.sentenceEn: We had grilled chicken breast with rice.
items.sentenceZh: 我們吃了烤雞胸肉配飯。

items.audioEn: The basketball player hurt his finger, so he won't play on Saturday.
items.audioZh: 那位籃球員手指受傷了，所以星期六不會上場。
items.questionZh: 那位球員為什麼星期六不上場？

items.sentenceEn: Her skin turned red after a day at the beach.
items.sentenceZh: 在海邊待了一天後，她的皮膚曬紅了。

items.sentenceEn: My aunt works at a hospital for cancer patients.
items.sentenceZh: 我阿姨在一家收治癌症病人的醫院工作。

items.stemEn: Swimming in cold water can take your ____ away.
items.stemZh: 在冷水裡游泳會讓你喘不過氣。

items.stemEn: After the ____, he couldn't walk for two months.
items.stemZh: 受傷之後，他有兩個月不能走路。

items.passageEn: During a game last month, Marco fell and hurt his knee. The pain was so strong that he couldn't catch his breath for a moment. The team doctor said the injury was not serious, but he needed rest. Marco had to cancel his holiday with his friends. While he rested at home, he read about how the body fights disease: our skin and cells repair themselves every day. Now he is back on the field, and he plays more carefully.
items.passageZh: 上個月比賽時，Marco 跌倒傷了膝蓋。痛到他一時喘不過氣。隊醫說傷勢不嚴重，但他需要休息。Marco 只好取消和朋友的假期。在家休息時，他讀到身體怎麼對抗疾病：我們的皮膚和細胞每天都在自我修復。現在他回到球場上了，踢得更小心。

questions.questionZh: Marco 為什麼取消了假期？

items.promptZh: 吸一口氣，然後慢慢吐出來。
referenceEn: Take a breath, and then let it out slowly.
Take a deep breath, then let it out slowly.
rubricZh: breath 是名詞「呼吸、一口氣」，例如 take a breath 等說法（動詞是 breathe）
「慢慢吐出來」可寫，例如 let it out slowly 等
祈使句用原形動詞開頭

items.instructionZh: 用 finger 造一個句子，說說你手指發生過的事或手指的用處。
referenceEn: I cut my finger when I was making dinner last week.
I wear my grandmother's ring on my middle finger.
rubricZh: finger 表示「手指」，可數名詞
說的是自己的經驗或習慣（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）
